how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-10.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8466:title: Feathers for Grazle
rows.quest:8466:desc:0: Some of the ⟦E5⟧ furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

rows.quest:8467:desc:0: Some of the ⟦E5⟧ furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
rows.quest:8469:title: Beads for Salfa
rows.quest:8469:desc:0: The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

rows.quest:8496:title: Bandages for the Field
rows.quest:8496:desc:0: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8497:title: Desert Survival Kits
rows.quest:8497:desc:0: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8498:title: Twilight Battle Orders
rows.quest:8498:desc:0: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

rows.quest:8501:title: Target: Hive'Ashi Stingers
rows.quest:8501:desc:0: Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8502:title: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
rows.quest:8502:desc:0: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

rows.quest:8507:title: Field Duty
rows.quest:8507:desc:0: Report for duty at the ⟦E8⟧ Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:8507:desc:1: Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the ⟦E8⟧ Brigade will flag you for PvP.
